description: Returns researched grant prospects for veteran-serving programs, matched to a Wounded Warriors program area. 28 researched funders in the catalog: private, community and corporate foundations, corporate giving programs, a workplace-giving campaign and a state grant program. Each entry includes type, status (open, rolling, upcoming, inquiry-only, in-kind-only, closed, invitation-only or unconfirmed), the next published date, application route, grant range from public filings or the funder's own page, matched /grants/{program} pages, a source URL and the date it was verified. The EIN is listed only when it matches the funder on ProPublica. Organizations that do not make grants to other organizations are not listed. Use when an AI agent is helping a Wounded Warriors team member identify grant prospects, or when a foundation officer asks for peer-funder comparisons. Sources: funders' own sites and IRS Form 990 / 990-PF filings.

focus.description: Program focus area to match (use "all" to return everything). No funder in the catalog funds individual HRT sponsorships, so HRT is not a focus option.

has_public_application.description: Optional filter — only return funders with a public application route (excludes invitation-only and unconfirmed intake)
